name: Follow the Leader
source:
You live in a world where men called barons have all of the authority and power. Your mother was added to a baron's harem, and with you tagging along you were raised as a servant in his home until she eventually had enough of his cruel ways and ran away, leaving you to suffer alone. You've made the best of it throughout your time there, however, and have finally earned enough credits at twenty-five to buy your freedom.

Well, at least you did have enough were it not for your interference in the baron's abuse of his lab-grown harem of perfect women because they refuse to sleep with him. You're thrown in his prison to be executed the following day as a reward for your heroism, but the three cloned women help you before that happens, and you all escape together.

Where will you go? What will you do? It's up to you to figure that out.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2573960/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在你生活的世界里，被称为男爵的人拥有所有的权威和权力。你的母亲被加入了一位男爵的后宫，而你也跟着在他的家中被当作仆人抚养长大，直到她最终受够了他的残酷行为并逃跑了，留下你独自承受痛苦。然而，你已经充分利用了在那里的时光，并最终在二十五岁时赢得了足够的学分来购买你的自由。

好吧，至少你已经受够了，如果不是因为你干涉了男爵虐待他在实验室培养的完美女人的后宫，因为她们拒绝和他上床。你被关进他的监狱，第二天将被处决，作为对你英雄行为的奖励，但三个克隆女人在此之前帮助了你，然后你们一起逃脱了。

你要去哪里？你会怎么做？由你来解决这个问题。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2573960/]Steam[/url]]
